verbatim_rows.long_context_rule: Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices. A request's prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes. Each request is priced on its own: a request over the threshold pays the higher prices even when part of its prompt is a cache hit, and earlier requests keep the prices they were billed at. The [model pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing#model-pricing) and [batch processing pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing#batch-processing) sections list both sets of prices.
